items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It might’ve been with Harvey Schwartz and maybe Jeff Williams.

ctx.x: Yes. I remember after they closed that place at Spring and Hudson and they moved it uptown, which was a bomb. It only lasted a year or two. It turned into a place they called “The Only-Est Place”. Do you remember that? Because I
remember hearing you there which just a bass. It might’ve been with Harvey Schwartz and maybe Jeff Williams. I don’t remember exactly.
This was after the life of the Half Note up there?
